thread:
carmen (CSM): Heads-up — OrbitCloud onboarding hit a tail-latency bump this morning; renewal signal is a bit soft. Thinking a proactive perf pilot.
neha (AM): FYI renewal in ~9 weeks, they're sensitive to token costs.
derek (SE): Alert looked like p99 spikes ~1.2s for long-context chat. p50 fine. Traffic has heavier long-tail seqs.
oliver (ML Eng): Proposal: 48h canary that routes 15% of read traffic to a compact/int8 combo with fallback. Expect ~20-30% cost savings on canary and better median latency.
marcus (PM): Need small eval set from recent calls to check quality delta before swap.
carmen (CSM): @bryce can OrbitCloud opt into a short canary? We'll monitor and rollback if needed. :eyes: 
bryce (OrbitCloud): Open to it if you share eval results and keep robust fallback. Who runs the rollout?
neha (AM): CS + SE will run pilot; ML validates quality; SE owns routing config and rollback.
derek (SE): I'll create route policy orbitcloud:compact_canary matching /v1/chat with header x-orbit-canary=1, weight=15%. Fallback to fp16 model on errors or latency triggers.
redwood-deploy-bot: deploy queued — route policy orbitcloud_compact_canary to staging.
derek (SE): Staging policy sample:
route_policy: orbitcloud_compact_canary; match: /v1/chat header:x-orbit-canary=1; variants: open-compact-int8 15%, open-base-fp16 85%; fallback open-base-fp16; quality_checks [sem-sim, rerank-f1]
oliver (ML Eng): I'll run ~200 recent convo evals: require semantic-similarity >0.95 and rerank-F1 within 3%. Posting results to #eng-ml.
marcus (PM): Capture KPIs: task completion, user-visible latency, NPS impact. Alert if task completion drops >2%.
carmen (CSM): Next steps: 1) derek deploys canary in staging & smoke tests; 2) oliver runs eval; 3) OrbitCloud opt-in flips header on 15% traffic; 4) 48h observation; 5) rollback criteria defined.
derek (SE): Staging smoke passed. Will start prod canary weight=0 then ramp.
redwood-deploy-bot: canary rollout started: orbitcloud_compact_canary weight=0 -> 15% over 10m.
oliver (ML Eng): Initial eval: semantic-similarity mean=0.966, median latency -12% on canary. 3/200 regression cases flagged (edge hallucination low-confidence). Logging examples.
bryce (OrbitCloud): Eval looks reasonable. Keep fallback and give daily summaries for 48h.
derek (SE): Added fallback on generation error or latency >900ms and a KV-cache tweak for their session patterns.
carmen (CSM): We'll collect daily feedback and prepare renewal note with savings if stable.
marcus (PM): Product needs before/after cost per 1k tokens for renewal deck.
oliver (ML Eng): Preliminary cost delta: ~24% reduction per 1k tokens on canary traffic; p50 -10%. Finalizing after 48h.
derek (SE): Routed the 3 regression user sessions back to fp16 immediately.
bryce (OrbitCloud): Appreciate the handling. Please escalate if anything odd.
carmen (CSM): Action items: [derek] monitor routing & rollbacks; [oliver] final eval report; [neha] prep renewal note with savings; [marcus] list KPIs and alert thresholds.
neha (AM): I'll draft the renewal one-pager once oliver confirms final savings. Target: 7 days.
redwood-deploy-bot: canary metrics snapshot: 15% traffic, error rate 0.02% (baseline 0.03%), p50 -11%, p99 -6% on canary.
oliver (ML Eng): Final eval posted: sem-sim 0.965, rerank-F1 delta -1.8%. Recommend continue observation to 48h then decide.
carmen (CSM): Thanks — we'll collect OrbitCloud daily feedback and sync with Renewals if metrics hold. Closing after 48h window unless incident occurs. :thumbsup:
